title: Recommending database configurations
summary: Tune database-scoped and instance settings for the workload.

items: Reason about compatibility level and MAXDOP.

blocks.body: Correct configuration is a prerequisite for good performance; DP-800 expects sensible recommendations.

terms.definition: Per-database settings like MAXDOP and legacy cardinality estimation.
Controls which query optimizer behaviors and features are enabled.

blocks.body: Use `ALTER DATABASE SCOPED CONFIGURATION` for settings such as `MAXDOP`, `LEGACY_CARDINALITY_ESTIMATION`, and query optimizer hotfixes. Set an appropriate **compatibility level** to opt into (or out of) optimizer changes safely.

tips: MAXDOP controls parallelism per query; too high can cause contention.

blocks.body: Match compatibility level and database-scoped settings (MAXDOP, CE) to your workload rather than accepting defaults blindly.
